attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The page says at the outset that Nicodemus does not have him in his Synaxaristes**, and that what it knows comes from a complete service preserved in Paris Codex 1575 folio 846, a poem of Joseph the Hymnographer; the source of the source is named here because it is all there is. **The page says his see is unknown** — «ήταν επίσκοπος (άγνωστο που)» — so there is no `office` field, and `bishop` stands in `types` without one. **No `dates` object**: the page names no century and no year, and the only date on it is that of the manuscript. **Joseph the Hymnographer is named as the author of the service and not as a person in his life**, so he takes no link and no `related` row. **No hymn is printed** — the page reports that a service survives; it does not print any of it. **Nothing in the corpus reads like the name.**
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
